sources.method: shopper survey, % of primary shoppers who bought in past year

changes_vs_current: Bananas jumps to #1 (current #9) and Strawberries holds top 2; Grapes/Watermelon/Apples/Oranges rise; Mango falls from #2 to #14 (it only wins on search volume, #1 there) and Pineapple from #4 to #8. Added: Lemons, Limes, Avocado, Nectarines. Dropped: Lychee, Papaya, Dragon Fruit, Passion Fruit (no source ranks them). Grapefruit (#24) is a no-data carryover.
confidence: medium - bananas/strawberries/grapes/watermelon/apples consistently top across sources, but only 2 full lists (one is 5 years old, one is truncated at 20 and excludes peaches/mango/cherries/oranges from view) plus a top-5 search list. Mango, Peaches, Avocado, Oranges placement is the shakiest. Avocado is a judgment call as a 'fruit' for players. Statista 2024 (n=1,050) confirms bananas #1 but ranks are paywalled; USDA per-capita data (2010) not used as too old.
